# ScribeCat 0.25.21

### PDF viewer
- Fit tall inline PDFs to about 90% of the available viewer height so the page stays complete without visually filling the entire editor.
- Center multi-page overview rows consistently.
- Add safe overview gutters so first/last thumbnails are not clipped.
- Keep partial overview rows centered and sized from their actual cells.
- Preserve the same PDF point when mobile pinch zoom begins, avoiding the jump to the top.
- Disable competing native pinch handling inside fullscreen PDF stages.

### Server and Docker
- Release metadata and Compose defaults are updated to 0.25.21.
- Publish `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.21`.
